# Cote d'Ivoire

Everything this library holds for Cote d'Ivoire, with provenance. Tilt = OLS slope of ln(rate) on wealth rank 0–1; ogcore consumes tilt ÷ 100 (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
